# Where a fractional yen comes from: tax.
#
# A yen has no minor unit, so no split can hold 103.5 JPY — but the tax on this
# invoice is exactly that. 2070 JPY at 5% is 103.5, and the figure has to reach
# a whole yen before it can be booked or printed. Half a yen is the rounding
# boundary, and GnuCash sends a half away from zero — so 104, not 103. Away
# from zero is not "up": the same rule takes -103.5 to -104.
#
# What this fixture produces, once imported and posted:
#
#   Assets:Accounts Receivable JPY     2174 JPY     (2070 + 104)
#   Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax JPY      -104 JPY     (GnuCash's rounding of 103.5)
#   Income:Sales JPY                  -2070 JPY
#
# and `print-invoice --format plaintext` writes `entry_tax: 104` /
# `invoice_total: 2174` on the invoice the customer receives.
#
# Three things are worth seeing here. Every figure is a whole yen — nothing
# reads 104.00, because a hundredth of a yen does not exist. The rounding is
# GnuCash's own: the engine posts 104 for this tax split, so the tool is
# agreeing with the ledger rather than deciding the direction itself. And the
# printed invoice is computed from the entry's tax_table, independently of the
# splits, so the two figures matching is the check that matters — an invoice
# that says 103 while the books say 104 would be sent to a customer as such.
#
# Verified by tests/unit/services/test_zero_decimal_currency_amounts.py
# (test_tax_on_a_yen_invoice_reaches_a_whole_yen).
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable JPY
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales JPY
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax JPY
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "JPY"

taxtable "Sales Tax JPY"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax JPY"
		rate: 5.0%
		type: PERCENT

customer "C-JP"
	name: "Japanese Customer"
	currency: JPY

invoice "INV-JPY-HALF"
	customer_id: "C-JP"
	currency: JPY
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Consulting, taxed at five percent (a half yen of tax)"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales JPY"
		quantity: 1
		price: 2070
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "Sales Tax JPY"
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable JPY"
		memo: "Invoice INV-JPY-HALF"
		accumulate: true
	payment: none
